items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: He played with Joe Banks' band in Thibodeau.

ctx.x: He played snare drum, bass drum, the ministry. He played an orchestra. He played with Joe Banks' band in Thibodeau. He played with Joe Gabriel after my daddy died.
Who were some of the other drummers you listened to when you were young?
